description:
Full sourced facts for one AI build tool, agent harness or Agent Toolbox entry.
Use when: you need pricing, licence, features or app stats for a single slug.
Do not use for: several tools at once (compare_tools).
Returns: pricing with pricing_checked and source, last_checked, app stats and Vibe Shipped links; or isError not_found.
Limits: Slugs come from list_tools, list_harnesses or list_agent_tools.
Example: {"slug":"lovable"}

slug.description: Tool, harness or Agent Toolbox slug, e.g. cursor, claude-code, cline.

name: get_tool
title: Get one AI build tool or agent tool
